images.title: An *AI Receptionist* for a veterinary clinic
images.sub: Reminders, surgery prep, records requests and after-hours calls, and the calls that stay with your team.

images.name: duties
images.title: The vet clinic front desk, *duty by duty*
rows: Works the due list for vaccines and exams, books replies and fills cancelled slots. Never messages about a deceased pet.
Sends fasting and drop-off instructions, confirms the night before, flags a pet that already ate.
Checks the owner's okay, then sends vaccine certificates to kennels, groomers and other clinics.
Takes the request, checks the last exam date and queues it for the vet. Never approves it.
Answers when the desk is busy or closed, from the clinic's own information.
Gives the clinic's written instructions and alerts staff right away.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at a *two-vet clinic*
rows: Sends a boarding kennel the rabies certificate it asked for overnight.
A dental patient's owner says the dog ate breakfast. It flags the surgery for the tech.
A Lab ate sugar-free gum. It gives the instructions and alerts a technician within a minute.
Queues a thyroid refill for the vet with the last exam date attached.
Texts 30 clients whose pets are due for vaccines and books the ones who reply.
A family asks about euthanasia for their old cat. A person takes the call.
Sends tomorrow's surgery instructions and confirmations, fills a cancelled slot.
After hours, a cat is straining in the litter box. It sends them to the emergency hospital and logs it.

images.name: setup
images.title: How an AI Receptionist *is set up* at a vet clinic
steps: With the medical director: the words that send a call straight to staff, and the after-hours instructions.
Tally a week of calls by type and write the booking rules for each visit, doctor and surgery day.
Practice management, phone, texting and the reminder tool, with only the access the job needs.
Symptoms, refills, end of life, estimates and upset clients go to a named person.
It drafts while the practice manager reads the log, then takes on more.
Update it when doctors, surgery days, prices or tools change.
